review_type: Read-only audit/freeze helper readiness review at the48-record first-pass snapshot

snapshot.scope: Record fields and event metadata only; page bytes hashed/concatenated without displaying text. No witness prose, notes, context, or image content opened; no audit/freeze command executed.

synthetic_validation_evidence.scope: Pure in-memory synthetic fixtures only. No task records, sessions, progress events, or files were changed. No begin/finalize/freeze command was invoked.

audit_begin.current_gate: All mapped page and record paths exist; prior mapped records have an audits list; no started/commit_pending session; current page hash matches record; no freeze/context marker.
audit_begin.event: scan NNN audit started YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS UTC cote=C audit_id=AUDIT_ID
audit_begin.effects: Actual start timestamp, baseline page/record hashes, immutable before snapshots and session. Does not mark a page audited.

audit_finish.event: scan NNN audited YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS UTC cote=C audit_id=AUDIT_ID
audit_finish.effects: Exact edits apply to current consolidated page; unchanged decisions/metadata persist; full root-supplied locus revisions and explicit removals update current projections; before/after snapshots and root payload remain in immutable history; completion line follows successful publication.

audit_recovery.conditions: Only previously authorized prepared revisions with root declarations and coherent before/after states. Recovery retains original audit timestamps and logs actual recovery time. Missing start may be restored from session; conflicting/duplicate starts or completion without any start require explicit reconciliation.

checks: Exact recursive mapped page/record filename sets and valid unique map identities
Current page hashes and record identities
Every session completed and matched to unique record audit IDs
Root completion declarations and all immutable history files present
Current page and record bytes identical to latest immutable audited revision
First done events and first completed audits in map order; all first done events precede first audit start; every session has exact matching timestamped events; no open or overlapping audit
Recognized event times never decrease; corrected lines ignored
Combined bytes exactly equal ordered page bytes without normalization
freeze.context_behavior: No context access or context-opened event is performed. A freeze or context-opened marker blocks another freeze. Root may open/log context after a committed freeze.

verification.behavior: Checks all107 frozen file hashes/sizes and unexpected page files against the committed manifest/hash block. Logs actual success/failure only with --write, including after context opens. Does not revalidate audit history or modify transcription.

helper_findings.summary: The non-finalizing audit preview returns before full record metadata/render validation.
helper_findings.evidence: A pure in-memory fixture with an out-of-bounds crop passes build_revision and fails only the later record metadata validator. Actual finalization stages rp.render, so it rejects this case before publishing a revised page.
helper_findings.impact: A successful preview is weaker than a successful commit preflight.
helper_findings.recommendation: Run complete record metadata and projection validation before returning the non-writing preview.

helper_findings.summary: Audit inventory patches can change a row to another scan and retain unsupported fields.
helper_findings.evidence: Pure in-memory fixtures with a mismatching scan identity and an unsupported inventory field pass both build_revision and validate_record_metadata.
helper_findings.impact: A root-authored patch with a mistaken scan label or field name can survive validation and produce misidentified or silently ignored inventory data. No current record has this defect.
helper_findings.recommendation: Restrict audit patch/addition fields and validate every resolved row's scan identity against its page record.

helper_findings.summary: Audit begin checks mapped page/record existence and earlier records' audit lists, rather than the complete first-pass event trail.
helper_findings.evidence: require_order does not inspect done events, exact recursive filename sets, or completed earlier session/log evidence. The freeze helper validates those later.
helper_findings.impact: The current 48-page snapshot is correctly blocked by 58 missing mapped pages, but begin is a weaker metadata gate than eventual freeze.
helper_findings.recommendation: Before the first real audit, validate all first-pass completion events and page identities; consider sharing the stronger gate in the helper.

helper_findings.summary: An exception is always reported with written=false, even after partial freeze preparation writes.
helper_findings.evidence: The manifest and hash block can be written before the final readiness recheck raises; main then prints written=false.
helper_findings.impact: The error JSON can misdescribe an existing uncommitted manifest/hash block. The final freeze marker is still withheld.
helper_findings.recommendation: Report preparation writes separately from committed freeze state; preserve and inspect partial preparation on error.

helper_findings.summary: Uncommitted-manifest reuse compares transcription files, ordered identities, and latest-audit summaries but not the prior full state fingerprint.
helper_findings.evidence: The state fingerprint is checked within one freeze attempt but is not stored in the manifest. A later retry revalidates current evidence without comparing its full byte fingerprint to the earlier attempt.
helper_findings.impact: This is a narrower retry identity guarantee than byte-identical audit evidence across attempts. No such change exists in the current unaudited snapshot.
helper_findings.recommendation: If retries must pin all recorded audit evidence, persist and compare the relevant fingerprint in the manifest.
